title: Valera and Contest
statementMd:
Valera loves to participate in competitions. Especially in programming contests. Today he has participated in the contest with his team, consisting of $*n*$ students (including Valera). This contest was an individual competition, so each student in the team solved problems individually.

After the contest was over, Valera was interested in results. He found out that:

- each student in the team scored at least $*l*$ points and at most $*r*$ points;
- in total, all members of the team scored exactly $*s*_{*all*}$ points;
- the total score of the $*k*$ members of the team who scored the most points is equal to exactly $*s*_{*k*}$; more formally, if $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$ is the sequence of points earned by the team of students in the non-increasing order $(*a*_{1} ≥ *a*_{2} ≥ ... ≥ *a*_{*n*})$, then $*s*_{*k*} = *a*_{1} + *a*_{2} + ... + *a*_{*k*}$.

However, Valera did not find out exactly how many points each of $*n*$ students scored. Valera asked you to recover any distribution of scores between the students of the team, such that all the conditions above are met.

## Input

The first line of the input contains exactly six integers $*n*, *k*, *l*, *r*, *s*_{*all*}, *s*_{*k*}$ ($1 ≤ *n*, *k*, *l*, *r* ≤ 1000$; $*l* ≤ *r*$; $*k* ≤ *n*$; $1 ≤ *s*_{*k*} ≤ *s*_{*all*} ≤ 10^{6}$).

It's guaranteed that the input is such that the answer exists.

## Output

Print exactly $*n*$ integers $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$ — the number of points each student scored. If there are multiple solutions, you can print any of them. You can print the distribution of points in any order.
statementZhMd:
<statement>
Valera 喜欢参加比赛，尤其是编程竞赛。今天，他和自己的团队参加了一场比赛，团队由 $*n*$ 名学生（包括 Valera）组成。这是一场个人赛，因此团队中的每名学生都是独立解题的。

比赛结束后，Valera 对比赛结果很感兴趣。他得知：

- 团队中的每名学生得分至少为 $*l*$ 分，至多为 $*r*$ 分；
- 团队所有成员的总得分恰好为 $*s*_{*all*}$ 分；
- 团队中得分最高的 $*k*$ 名成员的总得分恰好为 $*s*_{*k*}$ 分；更正式地说，若将团队学生的得分按非递增顺序排列，得到序列 $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$（$*a*_{1} ≥ *a*_{2} ≥ ... ≥ *a*_{*n*}$），则 $*s*_{*k*} = *a*_{1} + *a*_{2} + ... + *a*_{*k*}$。

然而，Valera 并不知道 $*n*$ 名学生各自的具体得分。请你构造一种团队成员的得分分配方案，使得上述所有条件都得到满足。

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含恰好六个整数 $*n*, *k*, *l*, *r*, *s*_{*all*}, *s*_{*k*}$（$1 ≤ *n*, *k*, *l*, *r* ≤ 1000$；$*l* ≤ *r*$；$*k* ≤ *n*$；$1 ≤ *s*_{*k*} ≤ *s*_{*all*} ≤ 10^{6}$）。

保证给出的输入数据一定存在满足条件的答案。

## 输出格式

输出恰好 $*n*$ 个整数 $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*$}，表示每名学生的得分。如果有多种方案，输出任意一种即可。可以按任意顺序输出这些得分。
</statement>
